title: Customer Support Analyst II
jobDescription:
General Summary

title: Customer Support Analyst III
jobDescription:
Job Summary:

We are seeking a highly skilled, customer-focused Customer Support Analyst (CSA) – Level 3 to provide advanced technical and functional support for our applications. This role serves as the final escalation point for complex issues and requires extensive research across multiple applications to diagnose, consolidate, and resolve customer-reported problems effectively. The ideal candidate will combine deep technical and functional troubleshooting with strong analytical thinking, enabling them to identify root causes, implement solutions, and drive continuous improvement in system performance and customer experience.

We are looking for a dedicated customer support analyst to join our team and provide customer support, technical and functional assistance, ensure application performance, and support users of our on-premises and AWS-hosted software products. The role involves troubleshooting, configuring systems, monitoring systems, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to resolve issues efficiently. Also, create KB articles, document process flow and user training.

Key RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Advanced Technical Troubleshooting & Resolution
  • Act as the primary escalation point (L3) for complex application, invoice, payment, and user access-related issues
  • Conduct in-depth research across multiple applications and systems to identify, correlate, and resolve issues
  • Analyze logs, alerts, configurations, and system behavior to troubleshoot problems efficiently
  • Provide end-to-end ownership from issue identification to resolution and customer confirmation
  • Multi-Application Analysis & Problem Solving
  • Investigate issues spanning multiple integrated applications, consolidating findings to determine root causes
  • Diagnose issues related to data flow, integrations, performance, and configurations
  • Apply structured troubleshooting methodologies to resolve cross-system dependencies
  • Incident & Escalation Management
  • Ensure timely resolution of support tickets, emails, and calls while adhering to defined SLAs
  • Proactively monitor alerts and logs to identify and mitigate potential issues before impact
  • Escalate issues appropriately with clear documentation and impact analysis
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Collaborate closely with Engineering, Product, Infrastructure, and other internal teams to resolve defects and performance issues
  • Translate customer-reported issues into clear technical insights and actionable inputs for internal teams
  • Participate in incident reviews and resolution planning
  • Root Cause Analysis & Continuous Improvement
  • Perform detailed Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for recurring and high-impact issues
  • Identify trends and recommend preventive measures and system improvements
  • Contribute to improving system stability and reducing ticket volumes
  • Knowledge Management & Documentation
  • Create and maintain knowledge base (KB) articles, troubleshooting guides, and runbooks
  • Document process flows, configurations, and standard operating procedures (SOPs)
  • Develop and deliver training materials and user guidance for both internal teams and customers
  • Customer Experience & Communication
  • Provide clear, structured, and professional communication to customers
  • Guide users through troubleshooting steps and ensure a high level of customer satisfaction
  • Manage critical customer interactions with ownership and accountability

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's/master’s in engineering or relevant qualification.
  • Minimum 4-10 years of experience in application support.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills for customer interaction.
  • Analytical and problem-solving mindset.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
  • Browser Support - Internet Explorer/Google Chrome etc.
  • Strong computer knowledge and troubleshooting skills.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills
  • Neutral accent
  • Should be confident & aggressive.
  • Candidate with prior application support experience is preferred.
  • Working knowledge of SQL Databases, IIS Setup & basic network configuration.
  • Working Knowledge of IT Hardware and Software.
  • Ability to learn and master employer-specific software.
  • Complex problem solving.
  • Ability to diagnose & address application issues.

title: Cyber Security Engineer III - 1612
jobDescription:
ROLE: Security Engineer III
Location: Hyderabad, India (Hybrid)
Department: Infrastructure/Info Security

About GHX:
GHX (Global Healthcare Exchange) is a leading healthcare technology company on a mission to simplify the business of healthcare and improve patient outcomes. Founded in 2000, GHX has built the GHX Global Network — the world’s largest cloud-based supply chain community connecting healthcare providers, suppliers, distributors, and partners to automate key processes, reduce costs, and increase operational efficiency. Its solutions span electronic trading, procurement automation, inventory and contract management, business intelligence, and data synchronization, helping healthcare organizations improve productivity and focus more on patient care. Over the years, GHX has enabled significant cost savings for the industry and continues to innovate with intelligent automation and AI-driven capabilities.

Website: https://www.ghx.com/
Linked In: https://www.linkedin.com/company/ghx/

Role Overview:
We are seeking a Cybersecurity Engineer with strong expertise in cloud security, Python‑based automation, and AI‑driven security capabilities. This role will focus on designing, automating, and enhancing security controls across cloud‑native environments, with an emphasis on AWS, intelligent threat detection, and the responsible use of AI/LLM technologies (including Claude). You will work closely with Cloud, Dev Ops, and Security Operations teams to embed security into modern architectures and improve detection, response, and resilience through automation and AI. \

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain security controls for AWS cloud environments
  • Develop Python‑based automation for security monitoring, alert enrichment, and incident response
  • Integrate and enhance AI‑driven security analytics for threat detection, anomaly detection, and behavioural analysis
  • Build and maintain integrations with SIEM, SOAR, EDR, and cloud‑native security tools
  • Automate vulnerability management, compliance checks, and security posture monitoring
  • Perform threat modelling and risk assessments for cloud workloads and architectures
  • Collaborate with Dev Ops teams to implement Dev Sec Ops and CI/CD security controls
  • Support incident response, threat hunting, and root cause analysis activities
  • Document security designs, automation workflows, and response playbooks

Required Skills & Experience

  • 4+ years of experience in Cybersecurity Engineering, Cloud Security, or Security Operations
  • Strong hands‑on experience securing AWS (IAM, networking, logging, encryption, monitoring)
  • Advanced Python skills for automation, APIs, and data analysis
  • Experience with SIEM, SOAR, EDR, and cloud security platforms
  • Solid understanding of incident response, threat detection, and MITRE ATT&CK
  • Experience working in hybrid or cloud‑native enterprise environments
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills

AI & Automation Focus

  • Practical understanding of AI/ML concepts applied to cybersecurity use cases
  • Experience using AI for:
  • Alert correlation and prioritisation
  • Anomaly and behaviour‑based detection
  • Threat intelligence enrichment
  • Familiarity with LLM security considerations, including data protection and prompt safety

Good to Have Qualifications

  • Hands‑on experience with Claude (Anthropic) or other LLM platforms in security use cases
  • Experience securing or integrating AI/LLM‑powered applications
  • Knowledge of CSPM, CWPP, and CIEM tools
  • Exposure to Kubernetes and container security
  • Infrastructure‑as‑Code experience (Terraform, Cloud Formation)
  • Security certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, AWS Security Specialty, GCED, or GCIH

Why Join Us

  • Work on modern cloud and AI‑driven security challenges
  • Opportunity to shape automation‑first and intelligence‑led security
  • Collaborate with experienced security, cloud, and engineering teams
  • High impact role with visibility across the organisation

title: Database Operations Manager
jobDescription:
Database Operations Manager

Job Summary

Reporting to the Director of Database Administration, the Database Operations Manager will lead and manage a team of 6 Database Operations Engineers across three shifts (24/7 operations) based in India. This role is responsible for ensuring the continuous availability, performance, and reliability of GHX's highly resilient corporate and cloud database infrastructure supporting GHX Daa S/Saa S solutions. The Database Operations Manager will oversee operational excellence, incident management, capacity planning, and team development while collaborating with Database Platform Engineering, Development, and Release Management teams to maintain operational standards and drive continuous improvement.

Roles and RESPONSIBILITIES:

Team Leadership & Management

  • Manage and mentor a team of 6 Database Operations Engineers distributed across three shifts (2 engineers per shift) to ensure 24/7 database operations coverage
  • Conduct performance evaluations, career development planning, and skills assessments for team members
  • Foster a culture of operational excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement
  • Coordinate shift schedules, on-call rotations, and workload distribution to maintain service levels
  • Provide technical leadership and escalation support for complex database incidents
  • Recruit, onboard, and train new team members as the team scales

Operational Excellence

  • Establish and maintain operational standards, runbooks, and procedures for database operations
  • Monitor team performance against SLAs, KPIs, and operational metrics (availability, response time, MTTR)
  • Lead incident response coordination for critical database outages and performance issues
  • Drive root cause analysis (RCA) and post-incident reviews to prevent recurrence
  • Implement and optimize alerting, monitoring, and observability strategies across all database platforms
  • Ensure compliance with operational and security policies throughout the service delivery lifecycle
  • Coordinate with Database Platform Engineering on database upgrades, patching, and best practices

Database Operations Oversight

  • Oversee administration and management of GHX databases across multiple platforms:

- Backup and recovery operations

- Capacity and performance monitoring

- Security and data access management

- Installations, upgrades, and patching

- Failover and disaster recovery management

  • Collaborate with development and release teams to provide operational feedback and support production deployments
  • Manage hybrid and cloud database infrastructure across AWS and on-premises environments
  • Drive automation initiatives to reduce manual operational tasks and improve efficiency

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Database Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, and SRE teams on infrastructure planning and architecture decisions
  • Coordinate with Development and Release Management teams on deployment planning and operational readiness
  • Provide operational insights to senior leadership through regular reporting and metrics dashboards
  • Participate in capacity planning, budget management, and resource allocation decisions
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for escalations and stakeholder communication during incidents

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited college in Computer Science or related discipline, or equivalent experience
  • 8-12 years of experience in Database Administration with at least 3-5 years in a leadership or management role
  • Proven experience managing distributed teams across multiple shifts or time zones
  • In-depth knowledge of multiple database platforms (Mongo DB, My SQL, Postgre SQL, Elastic Search, Redis, Oracle, SQL Server)
  • Strong understanding of hybrid and public cloud concepts, particularly AWS
  • Demonstrated ability to manage databases in high transaction/high availability environments
  • Experience with horizontal scaling, high availability, and disaster recovery technologies (e.g., Mongo DB Replica Sets, Oracle RAC & Dataguard, SQL Server 'Always On')
  • Hands-on experience with Linux/Unix and Windows operating systems in physical and virtual environments
  • Strong incident management and operational leadership experience in 24/7 production environments
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools (e.g., Datadog, New Relic, Pager Duty, Grafana, Prometheus)

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with database automation, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible), and CI/CD pipelines
  • Familiarity with ITIL, SRE principles, or other operational frameworks
  • Proven track record of driving operational improvements and reducing MTTR/MTTD
  • Strong critical thinking, analytical, and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills with demonstrated ability to lead and influence cross-functional teams
  • Outstanding written and oral communication skills with a commitment to high-quality documentation
  • Experience managing geographically distributed teams in different time zones
  • Ability to balance tactical operational needs with strategic planning and team development
  • Cultural awareness and experience working in global, diverse teams

Leadership Competencies

  • Servant leadership mindset with a focus on team enablement and growth
  • Strong decision-making skills under pressure during incidents
  • Ability to manage competing priorities and drive operational efficiency
  • Data-driven approach to problem-solving and continuous improvement
  • Excellent stakeholder management and escalation handling skills
  • Commitment to fostering psychological safety and inclusive team culture

jobDescription:
Position Summary

The Enterprise Tech Administrator I – End User Support is responsible for delivering high‑quality technical assistance to employees across the organization. This role ensures smooth operation of end‑user systems, resolves technical incidents, installs and configures hardware/software, and supports enterprise platforms in accordance with IT policies and service-level standards. The individual will work closely with global IT teams to enhance user experience and maintain a secure, compliant, and productive technology environment.

Key Responsibilities

End User Support

  • Provide Level 1 & Level 2 technical support for desktops, laptops, mobile devices, and peripherals.
  • Troubleshoot issues related to Windows OS, mac OS (optional), productivity tools, VPN, network connectivity, and enterprise applications.
  • Respond to incidents and service requests via ITSM tools within defined SLAs.
  • Assist users with onboarding and offboarding processes, including system setup and access provisioning.

Hardware & Software Management

  • Install, configure, and maintain end‑user devices (laptops, desktops, monitors, docking stations, etc.).
  • Manage software installations, upgrades, and license compliance.
  • Support imaging, deployment, and patching processes using enterprise tools (e.g., Intune, SCCM, Autopilot).

Enterprise Systems & Security

  • Assist with identity and access management using Azure AD/M365 tools.
  • Maintain endpoint security standards (antivirus, encryption, policy compliance).
  • Support enterprise collaboration tools (Microsoft 365, Teams, Outlook, Share Point, One Drive).

Network & VOIP Support

  • Provide basic troubleshooting for wired/wireless networks, VPN, and firewall access requests.
  • Support video conferencing systems, meeting room setups, and telephony/Vo IP equipment.

Documentation & Process Compliance

  • Maintain accurate records of issues, inventory, and resolutions in ITSM tools.
  • Create and update knowledge base articles for users and IT peers.

Vendor Coordination

Professional Experience

  • Minimum 1 – 3 years of Experience.

Technical Skills

  • Hands-on experience with Windows 10/11 administration.
  • Basic knowledge of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DHCP, DNS).
  • Familiarity with Microsoft 365, Azure AD, Intune, and endpoint management tools.
  • Experience with ITSM systems (Service Now, Jira Service Desk, Remedy, etc.).
  • Understanding of endpoint security tools and practices.

Soft Skills

  • Good communication and customer‑service orientation.
  • Ability to multitask and prioritize in a fast‑paced environment.
  • Team‑player with willingness to learn and grow.

Work Environment

  • Onsite 5 Days Work form Office.
  • May involve occasional after-hours or weekend support during critical activities.
